articles.title_en: The Economics of Spatial Mobility: Theory and Evidence Using Smartphone Data
articles.title_cn: 空间移动经济学：使用智能手机数据的理论和证据
articles.abstract_en: We develop a tractable quantitative framework for modeling the rich patterns of spatial mobility observed in smartphone data. We show that travel is frequently undertaken as part of a travel itinerary, defined as a journey starting and ending at home that can include more than one intermediate stop on a given day. We show that these travel itineraries provide microfoundations for consumption externalities and generate both complementarity and substitutability between locations. We show that the consumption externalities implied by travel itineraries are central to matching quasi-experimental evidence from the shift to working from home. We find that these consumption externalities are key drivers of the agglomeration of economic activity in central cities and shape the relative welfare gains from alternative transport improvements in favor of investments in central cities.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个易于处理的定量框架，用于对智能手机数据中观察到的丰富空间移动模式进行建模。我们表明，旅行经常作为旅行行程的一部分进行，旅行行程被定义为在家里开始和结束的旅程，其中可以包括在给定日期超过 一 个中间停留。我们表明，这些旅行行程为消费外部性提供了微观基础，并在地点之间产生了互补性和替代性。我们表明，旅行行程所隐含的消费外部性对于匹配在家工作转变的准实验证据至关重要。我们发现，这些消费外部性是中心城市经济活动集聚的关键驱动因素，并影响了替代性交通改善带来的相对福利收益，有利于中心城市的投资。

articles.title_en: Distributional Growth Accounting: Education and the Reduction of Global Poverty, 1980–2019
articles.title_cn: 分配增长核算：教育与减少全球贫困，1980-2019
articles.abstract_en: This article quantifies the role played by education in the reduction of global poverty. I propose tools for identifying the contribution of schooling to economic growth by income group, integrating imperfect substitution between skill groups into a macroeconomic growth decomposition. I bring this “distributional growth accounting” framework to the data by exploiting a new microdatabase representative of nearly all of the world’s population, new estimates of the private returns to schooling, and historical income distribution statistics. Education can account for about 45% of global economic growth and 60% of pretax income growth among the world’s poorest 20% from 1980 to 2019. A significant fraction of these gains was made possible by skill-biased technical change amplifying the returns to education. Because they ignore the distributional effects of schooling, standard growth accounting methods substantially underestimate economic benefits of education for the global poor.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文量化了教育在减少全球贫困方面所发挥的作用。我提出了一些工具，用于确定收入群体中学校教育对经济增长的贡献，将技能群体之间的不完全替代纳入宏观经济增长分解。我通过利用代表几乎所有世界人口的新微观数据库、对私人教育回报的新估计以及历史收入分配统计数据，将这种“分配增长核算”框架引入数据中。从 45% 到 60%，教育约占全球经济增长的 20%，占世界最贫困人口 1980 税前收入增长的 2019。这些成果的很大一部分是通过以技能为导向的技术变革放大了教育回报而实现的。由于标准增长核算方法忽视了学校教育的分配效应，因此大大低估了教育对全球穷人的经济效益。

articles.abstract_en: We study markup cyclicality in a granular macroeconomic model with oligopolistic competition. We first characterize how firm, sectoral, and aggregate markups comove with output at different levels of aggregation in response to firm-level shocks. We quantify the model’s ability to reproduce salient features of the cyclical properties of measured markups in French administrative firm-level data from the bottom (firm) level to the aggregate level. We document that (i) firm-level markups rise with market share and sector-level markups with concentration, (ii) the relationship between markups and sectoral output varies by firm size—negative for small firms but positive for large ones, (iii) sector-level markups move positively with sectoral output, and (iv) sectoral markups show no systematic relationship with aggregate output. Our model helps rationalize these seemingly conflicting patterns of markup cyclicality in the data.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究寡头竞争的细粒度宏观经济模型中的加价周期性。我们第一描述了企业、部门和总体加价如何与不同聚合水平的产出协同变化，以应对企业层面的冲击。我们量化了该模型重现法国行政公司级数据中从底层（公司）水平到总体水平的测得加价周期性特征的显着特征的能力。我们记录了：（i）公司层面的加价随着市场份额的增加而上升，部门层面的加价随着集中度的增加而上升，（ii）加成与部门产出之间的关系因公司规模而异——对小企业为负，但对大企业为正，（iii）部门层面的加价与部门产出呈正向变化，以及（iv）部门加价与总产出没有系统性关系。我们的模型有助于合理化数据中这些看似相互冲突的标记周期性模式。

articles.title_en: Are Inflationary Shocks Regressive? A Feasible Set Approach
articles.title_cn: 通胀冲击是否具有回归性？可行的集合方法
articles.abstract_en: We develop a framework to measure the welfare impact of macroeconomic shocks throughout the distribution. The first-order impact of a shock is summarized by the induced movements in agents’ feasible sets: their budget constraint and borrowing constraints. We combine estimated impulse response functions with micro-data on household consumption bundles, asset holdings, and labor income for different U.S. households. We find that inflationary oil shocks are regressive, but monetary expansions are progressive, and there is substantial heterogeneity throughout the life cycle. In all cases, the dominant channel is the effect of the shock on the cost of accumulating assets, not movements in goods prices or labor income.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个框架来衡量整个分配过程中宏观经济冲击对福利的影响。冲击的第一阶影响可以通过主体可行集的诱发运动来概括：预算约束和借贷约束。我们将估计的脉冲响应函数与不同美国家庭的家庭消费组合、资产持有量和劳动收入的微观数据结合起来。我们发现，通货膨胀性石油冲击是回归性的，但货币扩张是渐进性的，并且在整个生命周期中存在很大的异质性。在所有情况下，主要渠道是冲击对积累资产成本的影响，而不是商品价格或劳动收入的变动。

articles.title_en: Investor Memory and Biased Beliefs: Evidence from the Field
articles.title_cn: 投资者记忆和偏见信念：来自现场的证据
articles.abstract_en: We survey a large, representative sample of retail investors in China to elicit their memories of stock market investments and their return expectations. We merge these survey data with administrative transaction data to test a model in which investors selectively recall past experiences to form their beliefs. Our analysis uncovers new facts about investor memory and highlights similarity-based recall as a key mechanism of belief formation in financial markets. A rising market prompts investors to recall their past experiences more positively, leading to more optimistic forecasts of future returns. Recalled experiences can explain cross-investor variation in return expectations and, in our setting, dominate actual experiences in their explanatory power. In the transaction data, we confirm that recalled experiences are reflected in investors’ trading decisions through a belief channel.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们对中国散户投资者进行了大量、有代表性的调查，以了解他们对股市投资的记忆和回报预期。我们将这些调查数据与行政交易数据合并，以测试一个模型，在该模型中，投资者有选择地回忆过去的经历以形成他们的信念。我们的分析揭示了有关投资者记忆的新事实，并强调基于相似性的回忆是金融市场信念形成的关键机制。上涨的市场促使投资者更积极地回忆过去的经历，从而对未来回报做出更乐观的预测。回忆的经历可以解释投资者之间回报预期的差异，并且在我们的背景下，其解释力主导着实际经历。在交易数据中，我们确认回忆的经历通过信念渠道反映在投资者的交易决策中。

articles.title_en: Who You Gonna Call? Gender Inequality in External Demands for Parental Involvement
articles.title_cn: 你要打电话给谁？父母参与的外部需求中的性别不平等
articles.abstract_en: Gender imbalance in time spent on child-rearing causes gender inequalities in labor market outcomes, human capital accumulation, and economic mobility. We conduct a large-scale field experiment with a near universe of U.S. schools to investigate a potential source of inequality: external demands for parental involvement. Schools receive an email from a fictitious two-parent household and are asked to call one of the parents back. Mothers are 1.4 times more likely than fathers to be contacted. We decompose this inequality and demonstrate that the gender gap in external demands is associated with various measures of gender norms. We also show that signaling a father’s availability substantially changes the gender pattern of callbacks. Our findings underscore a process through which agents outside the household contribute to within-household gender inequalities.
articles.abstract_cn: 抚养孩子时间的性别不平衡导致了劳动力市场结果、人力资本积累和经济流动性方面的性别不平等。我们对几乎所有的美国学校进行了大规模的实地实验，以调查不平等的潜在根源：对家长参与的外部要求。学校收到来自虚构的二家长家庭的电子邮件，并要求学校给家长一回电话。母亲被联系的可能性是父亲的 1.4 倍。我们分解了这种不平等，并证明外部需求中的性别差距与各种性别规范衡量标准相关。我们还表明，发出父亲有空的信号会极大地改变回电的性别模式。我们的研究结果强调了家庭外部因素导致家庭内部性别不平等的过程。

articles.title_en: Insurance Versus Moral Hazard in Income-Contingent Student Loan Repayment
articles.title_cn: 收入相关学生贷款偿还中的保险与道德风险
articles.abstract_en: Student loans with income-contingent repayment insure borrowers against income risk but can reduce their incentives to earn more. Using a change in Australia’s income-contingent repayment schedule, I show that borrowers reduce their labor supply to lower their repayments. These responses are larger among borrowers with more hourly flexibility, a lower probability of repayment, and tighter liquidity constraints. I use these responses to estimate a dynamic model of labor supply with frictions that generate imperfect adjustment. My estimates imply that the labor supply responses to income-contingent repayment limit the optimal amount of insurance in government-provided student loans. However, these responses are too small to justify fixed-repayment contracts: restructuring existing student loans from fixed repayment to a constrained-optimal income-contingent loan—while keeping the tax and transfer system unchanged—increases borrower welfare by the equivalent of a 0.8% increase in lifetime consumption at no additional fiscal cost.
articles.abstract_cn: 与收入挂钩的还款学生贷款可以确保借款人免受收入风险，但会降低他们赚取更多收入的动力。通过澳大利亚收入相关还款计划的变化，我发现借款人减少了劳动力供应以降低还款额。这些反应在每小时灵活性更大、还款可能性更低、流动性限制更严格的借款人中更为明显。我用这些反应来估计劳动力供给的动态模型，其中的摩擦会产生不完美的调整。我的估计表明，劳动力供应对与收入相关的还款的反应限制了政府提供的学生贷款的最佳保险金额。然而，这些反应太小，不足以证明固定还款合同的合理性：将现有学生贷款从固定还款重组为受约束的最优收入或有贷款——同时保持税收和转移支付制度不变——增加借款人的福利，相当于终身消费的0.8%增加，而无需额外的财政成本。

articles.title_en: Conviction, Incarceration, and Recidivism: Understanding the Revolving Door
articles.title_cn: 定罪、监禁和累犯：了解旋转门
articles.abstract_en: Noncarceral conviction is a common outcome of criminal court cases: for every person incarcerated, there are approximately three who were recently convicted but not sentenced to prison or jail. We extend the binary-treatment judge IV framework to settings with multiple treatments and use it to study the consequences of noncarceral conviction. We outline assumptions under which widely used 2SLS regressions recover margin-specific treatment effects, relate these assumptions to models of judge decision-making, and derive an expression that provides intuition about the direction and magnitude of asymptotic bias when a key assumption on judge decision-making is not met. We find that noncarceral conviction (relative to dismissal) leads to a large and long-lasting increase in recidivism for felony defendants in Virginia. In contrast, incarceration (relative to noncarceral conviction) leads to a short-run reduction in recidivism, consistent with incapacitation. Our empirical results suggest that noncarceral felony conviction is an important and overlooked driver of recidivism.
articles.abstract_cn: 非监禁定罪是刑事法庭案件的常见结果：对于每一个被监禁的人来说，大约有三个最近被定罪但未被判入狱或看守所的人。我们将二元治疗法官 IV 框架扩展到具有多种治疗的环境，并用它来研究非监禁定罪的后果。我们概述了广泛使用的 2SLS 回归恢复特定边缘处理效果的假设，将这些假设与法官决策模型联系起来，并推导了一个表达式，该表达式提供了当不满足法官决策的关键假设时渐近偏差的方向和大小的直觉。我们发现，非监禁定罪（相对于解雇）导致弗吉尼亚州重罪被告的累犯人数大幅且持久地增加。相比之下，监禁（相对于非监禁定罪）会导致累犯的短期减少，这与丧失行为能力是一致的。我们的实证结果表明，非监禁重罪定罪是累犯的一个重要且被忽视的驱动因素。

articles.title_en: Present Bias Unconstrained: Consumption, Welfare, and the Present-Bias Dilemma
articles.title_cn: 不受约束的当前偏见：消费、福利和当前偏见困境
articles.abstract_en: By augmenting the continuous-time specification of Harris and Laibson (2013) with the assumption that hard borrowing constraints do not bind in equilibrium, present bias can be tractably incorporated into rich consumption-saving models featuring stochastic income, risky and illiquid assets, and costly borrowing. I present closed-form expressions characterizing how present bias affects consumption, illiquid asset demand, and welfare. This welfare analysis specifies the channels through which present bias can matter for policy and uncovers the present-bias dilemma: present bias can have large welfare costs, but individuals have little ability to alleviate these costs using financial commitment devices like illiquid assets.
articles.abstract_cn: 通过假设硬借贷约束不约束均衡，增强 Harris 和 Laibson（2013）的连续时间规范，可以将当前偏差轻松地纳入以随机收入、风险和非流动资产以及昂贵借贷为特征的丰富消费储蓄模型中。我提出了封闭式表达式，描述了当前偏见如何影响消费、非流动资产需求和福利。这种福利分析详细说明了当前偏见对政策产生影响的渠道，并揭示了当前偏见的困境：当前偏见可能会产生巨大的福利成本，但个人几乎没有能力利用非流动资产等金融承诺工具来减轻这些成本。

articles.title_en: The Macroeconomic Consequences of Exchange Rate Depreciations
articles.title_cn: 汇率贬值的宏观经济后果
articles.abstract_en: We study the consequences of “regime-induced” exchange rate depreciations by comparing outcomes for peggers versus floaters to the U.S. dollar in response to a dollar depreciation. Pegger currencies depreciate relative to floater currencies and these depreciations are strongly expansionary. The boom is associated with a fall in net exports, and (if anything) an increase in interest rates in the pegger countries. This suggests that expenditure switching and domestic monetary policy are not the main drivers of the boom. We show that a large class of existing models cannot match our estimated responses and develop a model with imperfect financial openness that can. Following a depreciation, uncovered interest parity deviations lower the costs of borrowing from abroad and stimulate the economy, as in the data. The model is consistent with (unconditional) exchange rate disconnect and the Mussa fact, even though exchange rates have large effects on the economy.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过比较固定汇率和浮动汇率对美元应对美元贬值的结果，研究“政权引发的”汇率贬值的后果。挂钩货币相对于浮动货币贬值，并且这些贬值具有强烈的扩张性。经济繁荣与净出口下降以及挂钩国家利率上升（如果有的话）有关。这表明支出转换和国内货币政策并不是经济繁荣的主要驱动力。我们表明，一大类现有模型无法与我们估计的反应相匹配，并开发了一个金融开放度不完善的模型来匹配我们的估计反应。正如数据所示，贬值后，未发现的利率平价偏差降低了从国外借款的成本并刺激了经济。尽管汇率对经济有很大影响，但该模型与（无条件）汇率脱节和穆萨事实一致。

articles.abstract_en: Observed international investment positions and cross-country heterogeneity in rates of return to capital are hard to reconcile with frictionless capital markets. This article develops a theory of international capital allocation: a multi-country dynamic spatial general equilibrium model in which the entire network of cross-border investment is endogenously determined. Our model features cross-country heterogeneity in fundamental risk, a demand system for international assets, and frictions that cause segmentation in international capital markets. We measure frictions affecting international investment and apply our model to data from nearly 100 countries, using a new dataset of international capital taxes and cultural, linguistic, and geographic distances between countries (geopoliticaldistance.org). Our model performs well in reproducing the composition of international portfolios, the cross section of home bias and rates of return to capital, and other key features of international capital markets. Finally, we carry out counterfactual exercises: we show that barriers to international investment reduce world output by 7% and raise the cross-country dispersion of capital per employee, contributing in a meaningful way to global inequality.
articles.abstract_cn: 观察到的国际投资头寸和资本回报率的跨国异质性很难与无摩擦资本市场相协调。本文发展了一种国际资本配置理论：一个多国动态空间一般均衡模型，其中整个跨境投资网络是内生决定的。我们的模型具有跨国基本风险异质性、国际资产需求体系以及导致国际资本市场分割的摩擦等特点。我们衡量影响国际投资的摩擦，并将我们的模型应用于来自近 100 个国家的数据，使用国际资本税以及国家之间文化、语言和地理距离的新数据集 (geopoliticaldistance.org)。我们的模型在再现国际投资组合的构成、本国偏好的横截面和资本回报率以及国际资本市场的其他关键特征方面表现良好。最后，我们进行了反事实练习：我们表明，国际投资的障碍使世界产出减少了7%，并提高了每名雇员资本的跨国分散度，从而对全球不平等产生了有意义的影响。

articles.title_en: What Drives Risky Prescription Opioid Use? Evidence From Migration
articles.title_cn: 是什么推动了处方阿片类药物的高风险使用？移民的证据
articles.abstract_en: We develop and estimate a dynamic model of risky prescription opioid use that allows us to unpack the role of person- and place-specific drivers of the opioid epidemic and assess the impact of state opioid policies. Event studies indicate that among adults receiving federal disability insurance from 2006 to 2019, moves to states with higher rates of risky use produce an immediate jump in the probability of risky use, followed by an additional gradual increase for the next several years. Using a potential-outcomes framework, we show how these results map to the person- and place-specific factors in the model. Model estimates imply large effects of place on both the likelihood of transitioning to addiction and the availability of prescription opioids; they also indicate that these place effects change significantly when state laws restricting pain clinics are enacted. A one standard deviation reduction in all place effects would have reduced risky use by about 40% over our study period. One particular source of place effects, pain clinic laws, reduced risky use by 5%, but could have reduced it by 30% if they had been enacted earlier, with much of this magnification operating through the dynamics of addiction.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发并估计了有风险的处方阿片类药物使用的动态模型，使我们能够揭示阿片类药物流行的特定于人和特定地点的驱动因素的作用，并评估国家阿片类药物政策的影响。事件研究表明，在2006至2019期间接受联邦残疾保险的成年人中，搬到风险使用率较高的州会导致风险使用概率立即跃升，然后在接下来的几年中逐渐增加。使用潜在结果框架，我们展示了这些结果如何映射到模型中的特定于人和地点的因素。模型估计表明，地点对成瘾的可能性和处方阿片类药物的可用性都有很大影响；他们还表明，当限制疼痛诊所的州法律颁布时，这些地方效应会发生显着变化。在我们的研究期间，所有场所效应的 一 标准差降低将减少约 40% 的风险使用。 一地方效应的特定来源、疼痛诊所法律，将风险使用减少了5%，但如果较早颁布的话，可能会减少30%，其中大部分放大作用是通过成瘾的动态作用的。

articles.title_en: Sexual Harassment in Public Spaces and Police Patrols: Experimental Evidence from Urban India
articles.title_cn: 公共场所和警察巡逻中的性骚扰：来自印度城市的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: We conduct a randomized controlled trial to evaluate the effect of an innovative police patrol program on sexual harassment in public spaces in Hyderabad, India. In collaboration with the Hyderabad City Police, we randomize exposure to police patrols and the visibility of officers by deploying both uniformed and undercover officers across 350 hot spots. To assess the effect, we implement a novel, high-frequency observation exercise to measure sexual harassment at these hot spots, where enumerators recorded all observed instances of sexual harassment and women’s responses in real time. We find that although police patrols had no effect on overall street harassment, uniformed police patrols reduced severe forms of harassment (forceful touching, intimidation) by 27% and reduced the likelihood of women leaving the hot spot due to sexual harassment. We uncovered the underlying mechanisms and found that both police visibility and officers’ attitudes toward sexual harassment are key to understanding its incidence.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们进行了一项随机对照试验，以评估创新的警察巡逻计划对印度海得拉巴公共场所性骚扰的影响。我们与海得拉巴市警察局合作，通过在 350 热点地区部署穿制服的警察和便衣警察，随机安排警察巡逻的情况和警察的可见度。为了评估效果，我们实施了一项新颖的高频观察活动来衡量这些热点地区的性骚扰情况，调查员实时记录所有观察到的性骚扰实例和女性的反应。我们发现，虽然警察巡逻对总体街道骚扰没有影响，但穿制服的警察巡逻将严重形式的骚扰（强力触摸、恐吓）减少了27%，并降低了妇女因性骚扰而离开热点地区的可能性。我们揭示了潜在的机制，并发现警察的可见性和警官对性骚扰的态度是了解性骚扰发生率的关键。

articles.title_en: From Public Labs to Private Firms: Magnitude And Channels of Local R&D Spillovers
articles.title_cn: 从公共实验室到私营企业：本地研发溢出的规模和渠道
articles.abstract_en: Introducing a new measure of scientific proximity between private firms and public research groups and exploiting a multibillion-euro financing program of academic clusters in France, we provide causal evidence of local spillovers from academic research to firms in the private sector. Our main estimate suggests that each €1 spent in academic research through this program spurred an additional €0.81 in private R&D expenditures. We also show that this shock increased the average quality of patents. We exploit reports produced by funded clusters, complemented by data on firm creation, labor mobility, and R&D public–private partnerships, to provide evidence on the channels for these spillovers. We discuss the policy implications of funding academic research to stimulate private R&D.
articles.abstract_cn: 通过引入一种新的衡量私营企业和公共研究团体之间科学接近度的措施，并利用法国学术集群的数十亿欧元融资计划，我们提供了学术研究对私营部门企业的当地溢出效应的因果证据。我们的主要估计表明，通过该计划在学术研究上花费的每欧元1都会刺激私人研发支出的额外欧元0.81。我们还表明，这种冲击提高了专利的平均质量。我们利用受资助集群生成的报告，并辅以有关企业创建、劳动力流动和研发公私伙伴关系的数据，为这些溢出效应的渠道提供证据。我们讨论资助学术研究以刺激私人研发的政策影响。

articles.title_en: Aggregation and the Estimation of Quality Change: Application to U.S. Import Prices
articles.title_cn: 质量变化的汇总和估计：对美国进口价格的应用
articles.abstract_en: We characterize the contribution of changes in quality, price, and variety entry/exit to the aggregate price index for smooth, invertible demand systems, generalizing the standard results derived in the CES case. The results require the knowledge of heterogeneous cross-product elasticities of substitution. To apply them in practice, we also show how to identify rich demand systems using data only on prices and market shares, without the need for external cost-shock instruments or strong assumptions on the covariance between supply and demand shocks. Using this approach, we compute the U.S. import price index based on the Kimball demand system. We find that quality change on average lowered the inflation in import prices by around 0.007 log points annually (1989–2016). To further validate our approach, we show that it estimates price elasticities and quality changes similar to those found by the standard mixed logit (BLP) demand in data on the U.S. auto market.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们描述了质量、价格和品种进入/退出的变化对平滑、可逆需求系统总价格指数的贡献，概括了 CES 案例中得出的标准结果。结果需要了解异质交叉产品替代弹性。为了将它们应用到实践中，我们还展示了如何仅使用价格和市场份额的数据来识别丰富的需求系统，而不需要外部成本冲击工具或对供需冲击之间的协方差进行强有力的假设。使用这种方法，我们根据金博尔需求系统计算美国进口价格指数。我们发现，质量变化平均每年将进口价格通胀降低约 0.007 个对数点（1989-2016）。为了进一步验证我们的方法，我们表明它估计的价格弹性和质量变化类似于美国汽车市场数据中标准混合 Logit (BLP) 需求所发现的结果。
